instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts dynamically in index.html or App.js (Rozha One, Cinzel, Montserrat, Noto Serif Devanagari).
Store host custom settings in localStorage so host edits reflect across all sections instantly.
Ensure all buttons have high-contrast hover states and explicit data-testid attributes.
Do NOT introduce dark mode or black backgrounds anywhere.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness with no horizontal overflow.
